items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: somebody like Paul Crawford, I don't know if you remember him from those days or not.

ctx.x: Well, I have a dual background. I have deep roots in Fluvanna County, Virginia. As well as in Richmond. I spent time in both places. I was born in Richmond, but my family, my grandparents on both sides lived in Fluvanna. And I spent all the summers up there and from time to time lived there as my mother drifted back and forth between the city and the country. So, but I, I, I went, I graduated from high school in Richmond, but I, when I was, my boyhood and early teen years I was in Fluvanna as much as I was in…

So, the more evangelical Protestant type of faith ties in with all those hymns, I guess. I mean, that's what, that's my guess. Yeah. And probably one of the reasons why I like them. Although, I don't remember them specifically, the hymns they were playing. But then, somebody like Paul Crawford, I don't know if you remember him from those days or not.
